title: Image-to-CAD worker tool contract
description: Messages API tool-use surface for the photo→cutlist worker. Write before loop code; handlers may stub until implemented.

tools.name: build
tools.description: Compile and run a helper-library script into solids / a parts model. Script errors return as tool results (not process crashes).

script.description: Python script using the allowlisted helper API (blocks, PartRecord).

tools.name: render
tools.description: Render named views of the current assembly (e.g. front, side, iso).

tools.name: measure
tools.description: Measure a part or blank (finished and/or blank T×W×L in mm).

part.description: Part id from the current parts model.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Geometry / likeness checks: bounding box vs targets, overlaps, silhouette IoU when a reference photo and render exist.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compare the reference photo to the latest render(s); return qualitative and/or IoU signals.

tools.name: lists
tools.description: Build cut list, material/buy summary, blank board-feet, and waste from the current parts model (or an explicit parts payload).

parts.description: Optional PartRecord dicts; defaults to last build parts model.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Pause the job and ask the human one short question (scale, hidden side, material). Phase 3 wires resume; Phase 1 CLI may return needs_user.
